result.stdout:
Usage: pnfmt [options] [<path> ...]

Options:
  -a, --all         Process all files in scope instead of only Git changes.
  -r, --recursive   Recurse into subdirectories when a path is a directory.
  -v, --verbose     Show detailed per-file logging and errors.
  -m[:N], -maxCpuCount[:N]
                     Process up to N files concurrently; omit N to use all CPUs.
      --file-pattern <glob>
                     Include only files matching the glob; repeat to include more.
      --formatter <name>[,<name>...]
                     Run only the named formatters; repeat or use comma-separated names.
                     Available names: csharp, csproj, ini, resx, rsp, slnx, xaml, xml.
  -n, --dry-run     Show what would change without writing files.
      --check       Exit with code 1 if any file would change (implies --dry-run).
      --lint        Report formatter diagnostics and formatting changes; exit 1 if found.
      --write-default-config
                     Write formatter .editorconfig and missing .pnfmt defaults.
      --migrate-legacy-config <true|false>
                     Import legacy formatter settings using current names.
      --remove-legacy-config <true|false>
                     Remove legacy settings after optional migration.
  -h, --help        Show this help.
  -V, --version     Show version info.

Notes:
  If no path is provided, the current directory is used.
  maxCpuCount defaults to the repository .pnfmt value, or 1.
  Registered formatters support .cs, .csproj, .editorconfig, .ini, .resx, .rsp, .slnx, .xaml, .xml files.
  Set pnfmt_enabled = true and pnfmt_formatter = <name> in .editorconfig to enable processing.
  pnfmt_enabled = false skips all processing, including lint; formatter None also skips it.
  pnfmt_format controls layout (default true); sorting and cleanup require their own switches.
  Missing enablement or selection retains compatibility behavior with warning PNFMT004.
  A future version will require explicit enablement and formatter selection.
  --formatter filters t
